name: La Nucia (Spain)
description: Dark red field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of La Nucia (a crowned shield with the Senyera and a bend with fleurs-de-lis).
history: Municipal flag of La Nucia; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: La Nucia arms — Senyera with a bend of fleurs-de-lis
